responsibility: Provides the handwritten preamble, shared helpers, and target-aware utility logic for the autogenerated gimple-match.cc simplifier. It defines common matcher entry scaffolding, conditional-operation conversion and resimplification support, canonicalization and commutativity/associativity queries for code_helper operations, target-support tests, and miscellaneous fold heuristics that the generated GIMPLE pattern matcher relies on when simplifying expressions and internal-function calls.
